title: Build the first evidence-linked near-term preservation risk register
acceptanceCriteria: At least ten risks have sources, indicators, uncertainty, reversible responses, and named approval boundaries.
verificationMethod: Fresh reviewer checks every source, ranking rationale, and authority classification.
rollback: Retain the previous register and retire the superseded assessment with an audit event.
authorityReasons: public-information analysis and local artifact preparation only

title: Create a preregistration-ready registry of discriminating consciousness predictions
acceptanceCriteria: Each prediction states a measurement, pass/fail criterion, confounders, and interpretation agreed or disputed by theory proponents.
verificationMethod: An independent domain-focused agent reviews falsifiability and theory neutrality on the exact head, followed by a separate hosted agent repository review. Human escalation is reserved for institutional ethics approval or legal consent before any execution.
rollback: Version the registry and preserve rejected predictions with reasons.
authorityReasons: public-information analysis and branch preparation only

title: Run a bounded fault-recovery simulation against explicit durability metrics
acceptanceCriteria: The result reports positive, negative, or null evidence without interpreting simulation success as physical demonstration.
verificationMethod: Independent deterministic replay with the same caller-supplied seeds and timestamps.
rollback: Revert the isolated simulation branch and retain the failure log as evidence.
authorityReasons: local simulation with no hardware or deployment

title: Map institutional continuity dependencies and evidence gaps
acceptanceCriteria: The map distinguishes repository artifacts, evidence strength, readiness, and external outcomes for every dependency.
verificationMethod: Fresh reviewer samples sources and challenges capture, succession, and funding assumptions.
rollback: Preserve the previous map and record a superseding assessment.
authorityReasons: public-information analysis only; no outreach or governance mutation

title: Compare candidate consciousness indicators against discriminating predictions
testsOrPreregistration: blind consistency review against the prediction registry
acceptanceCriteria: Every indicator is linked to discriminating predictions, counterexamples, uncertainty, and a stated falsification condition.
verificationMethod: An independent agent checks source traceability, theory neutrality, and every claimed prediction linkage on the exact artifact.
rollback: Retain the previous prediction registry and retire the comparison artifact with an audit event.
authorityReasons: bounded public-information analysis with no external action or welfare-status declaration
